description: HZgamma lepton pT DSCB pull parameters (pelai, v3 production). Pull = (pt_reco - pt_gen_dressed_matched) / lepton_ptErr, with ptErr = Muon_ptErr for muons and Electron_energyErr*sin(theta) for electrons. Binning is ours, not the 3x3x3 grid of kin_refit_params2_V1.json; 'year' keys are the 11 HZgamma eras, not coarse years. Muons have a single absdxy bin on purpose.

inputs.name: absdxy
inputs.description: Muon abs dxy (single bin: axis not used)
